newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks close down in narrow trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks close down in narrow trade.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed down in range-bound trade on Monday amid a mismatch between buyers and sellers in the market, brokers said.
The all share index closed 1.94 points down at 729.10. Losers outnumbered gainers by 35 to 18. Ceylon Tobacco fell one rupee to 42 and Hayleys one to 225.
"Trading is being hit by a mismatch between buyers and sellers, who are waiting at very different price levels," said Shanil Perera of Lanka Securities.
Buyers are waiting at lower levels to see if their absence will depress prices further and sellers are holding out at higher levels, he said.
